payload.goal: Add expense categories to the splitter. Extend the Expense type with an optional category field that must be one of exactly "food", "transport", "lodging", "entertainment" or "other", rejecting any other value, add computeCategoryTotals to the domain, expose listCategoryTotals from the API layer, render a category breakdown in the web surface, and cover the new behaviour with tests. Preserve the existing balance behaviour and keep the current tests green.

expectedOutcomes: Expense category accepts only food, transport, lodging, entertainment, or other when present.

computeCategoryTotals returns totals grouped by allowed category.

children.title: API category totals exposure
children.objective: Expose listCategoryTotals from the API layer using the domain category-total computation and rejecting unsupported category values through the existing expense API boundary.
expectedOutcomes: API behavior delegates category calculation to the domain implementation.
Unsupported category values are rejected before successful API results are returned.

children.title: Web category breakdown
children.objective: Render a category breakdown in the web summary surface using the API/domain category totals while keeping the existing balance summary behavior intact.
expectedOutcomes: Summary output includes a category breakdown.
Rendering handles omitted categories consistently with computeCategoryTotals.
Existing balance summary output remains present and unchanged except for the added category section.
